newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Star Banc '97 EPS view up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Star Banc '97 EPS view up.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it raised its 1997 earnings-per-share estimate on Star Banc Corp to $2.10 from $2.02. It said its initial 1998 EPS estimate is $2.35, consistent with EVEREN's projected EPS growth rate of 12 percent annually for the company.

--Star Banc's 1996 Q4 earnings of $0.48 a share were 20 percent higher than a year earlier and in line with EVEREN's expectations. The company recognized $2.4 million of securities, implying that recurring earnings were $0.50 per share, EVEREN said.
